old:
if (judged.has(key)) return true;
    if (!me || t < bl.at) return false;

name: KTF-the-late-landing-judged
old: if (alive && !judged.has(key) && t - bl.at <= KT_LATE_MS + Math.max(1, bl.sp ?? 0)) judge(key, bl, t, me);
why: judge() asks egBlowVerdict with KT_LATE_MS, which answers 'miss' past a landing's span and the late margin - so the frame's own window only marks a stale blow judged without asking; with it gone the verdict refuses the same blow and marks it the same. Kept because it spares the verdict a blow a frame never needed, and the next reader should know the verdict is the law (pinned: A LANDING SEEN TOO LATE).

name: KTF-an-owed-blow-off-the-bridge
old: if (alive && me && onBridge(me[0], me[2], 1.5) && Math.abs(me[1] - KT_BRIDGE.y) <= 4) land(bl);
